slides.title: The Sunday reset.
slides.body: 20 minutes that set the whole week.

slides.body: What got done. What didn't. No judgment, just data.

slides.body: Three outcomes for the week. Not ten. Three.

slides.title: Give each one a time.
slides.body: Put them on the calendar. If it has no time slot, it's a wish.

slides.title: Set the first move.
slides.body: Decide exactly what Monday's first hour is for, tonight.

slides.title: Clear the deck.

slides.title: Build a morning that runs itself.
slides.body: Five settings. Set them once.

slides.title: Fix the wake time.
slides.body: Same time, seven days a week. Rhythm does what willpower can't.

slides.title: Decide the night before.
slides.body: Clothes out. First task written down. No decisions at 6 a.m.

slides.title: Move first.
slides.body: Ten minutes. Walk, run, stretch. Anything that gets you out of your head.

slides.title: Phone last.
slides.body: The first hour is yours. Messages can wait until it's over.

slides.title: One hard thing before noon.
slides.body: Do the task you most want to avoid while your focus is fresh.

slides.title: Try it for [[7 days]].
slides.body: Save this. Run like clockwork.

slides.title: The 10-minute shutdown.
slides.body: End the day so tomorrow starts itself.

slides.title: Close the loops.
slides.body: Write down every open task still in your head. Paper holds it so you don't have to.

slides.title: Pick tomorrow's first task.
slides.body: One task. Written where you'll see it before anything else.

slides.title: Check tomorrow's calendar.
slides.body: Two minutes now saves a surprise at 9 a.m.

slides.title: Reset the space.
slides.body: Clear the desk. Wash the cup. Leave the room ready for the morning.

slides.title: Set a hard stop.
slides.body: Pick an end time and keep it. Work that runs late steals from tomorrow.

slides.title: Save this for [[tonight]].
slides.body: Run like clockwork.

slides.title: The focus block.
slides.body: One hour of real work a day. Here's the setup.

slides.title: Book the same hour.
slides.body: Same time every weekday. It's an appointment, not a hope.

slides.title: Name one task.
slides.body: Write it down before the block starts. One task, not a list.

slides.title: Phone in another room.
slides.body: Not face down. Not on silent. Out of reach.

slides.title: Run a timer.
slides.body: 50 minutes on, 10 off. When it rings, stop, even mid-sentence.

slides.title: Log the block.
slides.body: Tick a box on paper. Five ticks is a good week. Track it.

slides.title: Save this for your next [[focus block]].
slides.body: Run like clockwork.

slides.title: Keep your routine through the holidays.
slides.body: A long weekend shouldn't cost you a month.

slides.title: Pick one anchor.
slides.body: One habit that happens every day, wherever you are. Ten minutes counts.

slides.title: Move in the morning.
slides.body: A walk or a short session before the day fills up. Then enjoy the day.

slides.title: Hold the wake time.
slides.body: Within an hour of normal. Sleep in a little, not a lot.

slides.title: Be fully off.
slides.body: Rest is on the plan. Put the phone away and be with the people in front of you.

slides.title: Book the restart.
slides.body: Put Monday's first session on the calendar before the weekend starts.

slides.title: Save this for the [[long weekend]].
slides.body: Run like clockwork.
